feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 3 June 2026 11:13am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 03 June 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the northwest of Ireland as a frontal zone continues to clear the Irish Sea area. Further troughs or fronts approaching from the west thereafter.


##Wind##

South or southeast 5 to 7, quickly veering south or southwest 5 or 6 and occasionally 7 in the east, veering west or southwest 4 to 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough in the south until later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle continuing to clear to the east with showers following from the west, some may be heavy at times.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain/drizzle/showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 5 or 6, increasing occasionally 7 in the east, backing southwest 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or showers becoming isolated later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers.
